label: Turn off airplane mode
guide: Swipe down twice from the top of the screen.
Tap Airplane mode so that it turns grey.

label: Turn off Do Not Disturb
guide: Swipe down twice from the top of the screen.
Tap Do Not Disturb so that it turns grey.

label: Turn on mobile data
guide: Swipe down twice from the top of the screen and tap Internet (or Mobile data).
Turn on Mobile data.

label: Turn on Wi-Fi
guide: Swipe down twice from the top of the screen and tap Internet (or Wi-Fi).
Turn on Wi-Fi and choose your network.

label: Turn off Data Saver
guide: Open Settings, then Network & internet, then Data Saver.
Turn off Use Data Saver.

label: Set the time automatically
guide: Open Settings, then System, then Date & time.
Turn on Set time automatically.

label: Turn off Private DNS
guide: Open Settings, then Network & internet, then Private DNS.
Choose Automatic or Off, then tap Save.

label: Switch the ringer from silent or vibrate to ring
guide: Press a volume button, then tap the bell icon above the slider until it shows a ringing bell.

label: Turn up the ring volume
guide: Open Settings, then Sound & vibration.
Drag Ring volume to the right.

label: Turn up the call volume
guide: During a call, press the volume-up button until the sound is loud enough.

label: Move call sound from Bluetooth to the phone
guide: During a call, tap the audio or Bluetooth button on the call screen.
Choose Phone (or Earpiece).

label: Turn off TalkBack
guide: Press and hold both volume buttons together for three seconds.
If that doesn't work, open Settings, then Accessibility, then TalkBack, and turn off Use TalkBack. With TalkBack on, tap once to select and twice to press.

label: Turn off colour inversion
guide: Open Settings, then Accessibility, then Colour and motion.
Turn off Colour inversion.

label: Turn off greyscale
guide: Open Settings, then Accessibility, then Colour correction.
Turn off Use colour correction.

label: Make the screen brighter
guide: Swipe down from the top of the screen and drag the brightness slider to the right.

label: Keep the screen on for one minute
guide: Open Settings, then Display, then Screen timeout.
Choose 1 minute or longer.

label: Turn on auto-rotate
guide: Swipe down twice from the top of the screen.
Tap Auto-rotate so that it turns on.

label: Make the text bigger
guide: Open Settings, then Display, then Display size and text.
Drag Font size to the right.

label: Turn on Bluetooth
guide: Swipe down twice from the top of the screen.
Tap Bluetooth so that it turns on.

label: Reset network settings
guide: This removes all saved Wi-Fi passwords and Bluetooth pairings. Write down your Wi-Fi password first.
Open Settings, then System, then Reset options.
Tap Reset Wi-Fi, mobile & Bluetooth, then Reset settings.
